lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ask me anything.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Just be sure to add a question mark at the end.
When are you going to grow taller?
How is life as a third-year student?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (My height.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (Despite my belief that)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (I have been growing steadily at an incremental rate,)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (my actual height has not changed one iota in the past six months.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (Satisfactory.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (Many things have changed, despite moving up only one grade.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (There is a feeling that all of my blood, sweat and tears during my first two years has paid off.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (Having said that, I did not actually experience any truly traumatic events in that time period.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (I was merely using a figure of speech.)
... What is going on?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hee-hee.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's an AI I made with Naru 1, 2, and 3.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It can answer questions automatically.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: So long as there is a question mark at the end of a sentence, it will be recognized as a question.
Its answers are a bit... unorthodox.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: True...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: There are still some kinks I need to work out.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It should be fine after I do some tinkering around.
A few kinks, huh?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yeah.
Do you remember what you learned in class today?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (I slept for approximately 4 hours during today's lesson.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (I am unable to recall what I learned.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Shut up, will you?!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Perhaps I should implement a feature

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: that allows it to lie.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Erm, I mean...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I should allow it to only answer certain questions and not others.
Have you finished all your homework?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: For the love of God, please stop asking questions!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (Although I know of this thing called 'homework',)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (I have not dedicated much time to completing it. No time at all, in fact.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (When I go to school tomorrow, I will suck up to the teachers.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: (This is an approximation of the user's thought process.)

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm thinking I should pull the plug on this whole AI idea.
That's probably a good idea.
